name: 80925 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80925 (Colorado Spgs) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80925 (Colorado Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80925 (Colorado Spgs) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 20% of the typical level).
